correctness.rationale: The ring product is associative with cube zero and its brace Yang--Baxter map is involutive; two-sided flips are exactly two simultaneous bilinear-zero tests. Matrix rank yields cosquare eigenvector formula for every d. For d=2, trace and discriminant of the cosquare yield four possibilities. Symmetric matrix determinant counts and an exact quadratic character sum derive all four multiplicities; special h=0, alternating, and nontrivial Jordan cases are handled separately. The four totals sum to |GL2(Fq)|. Standard-library verifier exhaustively reproduces the predicted histogram for q=3,5,7,11 and all Yang--Baxter triples at q=3. Finite tests are corroborative, not a general proof.

originality.rationale: Accessible relevant primary full texts were checked for the exact claim. Prior papers establish four probability definitions and bounds (Ferrara et al.), a specific alternating example (Ferrara et al.), and the underlying brace matrix classification for prime fields (Bachiller). None of these is asserted novel. The assessed new fact is the uniform general cosquare probability formula together with complete exact labeled GL2 matrix spectrum, including nonsymmetric strata, over every odd prime power. Searches located no direct covering theorem. Priority risk from an equivalent older matrix-cosquare distribution is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The central observable introduced in the 2026 primary paper is the probability of a simultaneous flip. This natural family demonstrates a sharp separation between universal one-sided probabilities and the discriminating two-sided invariant, gives every possible value and exact occurrence frequency over all nondegenerate bilinear products in rank two, and identifies the structural cause (cosquare eigenspaces) in every rank. No general downstream theorem is needed for the precise complete natural census to have value; the result is not a recomputation of the known alternating example.
